name: cache_manager
description: Incremental content-addressed cache for analysis, build results, dependency graphs, and brain data. Invalidates entries when their declared inputs (file hashes, module IDs, constitution versions) change. Embodies Engineering Law 8 (Cache Aggressively) and Law 14 (Knowledge Persistence).

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Cache key, typically AIOS-HASH-{sha256_first_12} of the inputs.

inputs.name: producer_module_id
inputs.description: Module that produced the value, e.g. AIOS-MODULE-000005 (brain).

inputs.name: input_hashes
inputs.description: [{ path or symbol, sha256 }] that this entry depends on. An entry is invalid if any hash changed.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: Cached value, or null on miss.

error_codes.message: Stored value failed schema re-validation on read.
error_codes.recovery: Drop the entry, return miss, log AIOS-EVENT-000017 cache_corrupt. Do not return corrupt data.

error_codes.message: Cache at performance_budget.max_cache_mb and prune could not free enough.
error_codes.recovery: Evict least-recently-used entries; if still full, return miss and continue uncached.

examples: get(key=H, inputs=[file_a@hash1]) -> hit only if stored entry's input_hash for file_a still equals hash1.
